div.div:
x ^ x = 0 and x ^ 0 = x.
XOR is order-independent, so every duplicate annihilates itself no matter where it sits.

div.div: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest 1 and fills the zeros below it. ANDing puts every one of those bits back to 0.

div.div: The loop runs once per set bit, not once per the 32 bits in the word.
